column1: # VERSION LEDGER — which PLATFORM SUBMISSION is which LOCAL BOT TREE.
# WHAT THIS IS. `ladder_games.tsv.ourver` and `league_matches.tsv.teamAVersion`
# carry a bare integer (125). The shard worklist, PROGRAMME.md and every prereg
# carry a directory (bots/_v197mapcode). Nothing joined the two: the sentence
# "v125 is _v197mapcode and it was named Loki v8" lived only in prose, in three
# different files, and a page that wanted to say it had to guess. This file is
# that join, and it is the surface tools/dash reads for every version label.
# ⛔ SEEDED ONLY FROM WRITTEN ANCHORS. Every row below cites a file:line (or a
# commit) whose verbatim text states the mapping, and every one of those lines was
# re-read before the row was written. No row is inferred from a directory name —
# the numbers do not even coincide (`bots/_v197mapcode` is submission v125, and
# `_v115dodge` is v92 AND v94 AND v101).
# ⛔ ABSENCE MEANS UNKNOWN, NOT GUESSED. A version or a tree that is not here is
# one we could not anchor, NOT one that does not exist — v105-v111, v113, v117,
# v118 and v119 were all real submissions whose name and tree are not written down
# anywhere on this box. An EMPTY `name` cell means the same thing at field level:
# no anchor states the platform name (v115, v120 are teammate ships; v94/v101/v102
# are ours but were uploaded before names were used). Consumers must render the
# absence as an absence.
# `tree` = `none (teammate)` is a POSITIVE fact, not a missing value: a version
# activated by a teammate on the shared account, for which no tree exists in this
# repo by construction.
# WHO MAINTAINS IT. `tools/submit_clean.py` appends a row after every successful
# submit, with the tree it staged, the --name it passed, and the version string
# `fcode status` returned on its `Active bot:` line (evidence `submit_clean auto`).
# That append is wrapped so no failure of it can touch the submit flow — so if the
# ship chain is ever noisy here, the ledger is what is wrong, not the ship.
# Rows seeded by hand carry their own anchor instead.
# COLUMNS  version  name  tree  evidence  recorded_at
#   version     the platform submission number, bare, exactly as it appears in
#               ladder_games.tsv.ourver / league_matches.tsv.teamAVersion
#   name        the submission name on the platform ("Loki v8"), empty if unanchored
#   tree        repo-relative bot directory, or `none (teammate)`
#   evidence    file:line or commit hash — the anchor, quoted where it fits
#   recorded_at when THIS ROW was written (not when the version shipped)
